implementation.prepare_load: loads and validates conditioning, model weights, Core ML models and shared backing without denoise, VAE decode or output
implementation.prepare_warmup: runs a full no-output request after optional per-branch zero-input Core ML warmup

workload.execution: GPU plus checkpoint-bound Core ML a4096 prefix

observations.model_load_is_os_cache_sensitive: 0.24 to 6.88 seconds in these ordered single samples
observations.interpretation: prepare moves startup work before the user-visible generation request; it does not reduce total synchronous work when prepare and generate are summed

limitations: Each route currently has one ordered sample; OS file cache and Core ML internal cache state differ between runs.
These measurements separate phases and prove lifecycle behavior, but they are not an ABBA performance qualification.
The public Core ML API reports CPUAndNeuralEngine compute units but does not prove actual ANE residency.
Manifest validation currently hashes the checkpoint and is a material startup cost; any future cache must preserve content/provenance safety.
The raw reports and generated PNGs are local gitignored artifacts under outputs/.

decision.load_only_prepare: implemented and validated for Z-Image and native LLaDA text-to-image
decision.startup_hidden: yes, when prepare runs before the latency-sensitive generation request
decision.zero_input_warmup_default: not enabled globally; the single sample improved the next request by about 2.7 percent but adds preparation work
